question: Should Discord subagent progress extend the existing source-message status lifecycle, or become a separately configurable reaction and typing lifecycle?
rationale: Either design can implement the feature, but the choice creates permanent configuration, plugin API, persisted-state, message-delivery, and lifecycle-ownership contracts that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Extend canonical lifecycle
options.body: Integrate subagent count, failure, and typing state into the existing Discord status owner while keeping the core notification seam generic and cycle-free.

options.title: Approve separate tracker
options.body: Explicitly support the new Discord-specific lifecycle and accept ongoing coordination with existing status reactions and typing.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the PR if a second permanent lifecycle and configuration surface is not currently worth maintaining.

recommendation.title: Extend canonical lifecycle
recommendation.body: Integrate subagent count, failure, and typing state into the existing Discord status owner while keeping the core notification seam generic and cycle-free.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main history most directly connects this person to both affected lifecycle boundaries.
